reviewMethod: Codex drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Random selection, summons, and qualification forms
headings.reviewNote: Read presiding/designated judge order, master list and board manner, mailed or personal summons/form.

headings.title: Disqualification, notice, and removal from the grand jury list
headings.reviewNote: Disqualified candidates not required to comply with summons; no punishment implied.

headings.title: Grand jury list and later disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Later deletion specifically from master list, unlike prior grand-jury-list provision.

headings.title: Selection of twelve grand jurors and alternates
headings.reviewNote: Judge supervision, alternates on death/disqualification/inability, selected names removed from grand jury list.

headings.title: Convening, service terms, and limited extensions
headings.reviewNote: Six-month service plus up-to-sixty-day extension only existing matters; another jury may convene.

headings.title: Grand juror compensation
headings.reviewNote: Amount cross-referenced to petit jurors, no unsupported current dollar figure.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all six subsections and history. Random selection precedes judicial choice of twelve members and alternates. Source distinguishes deletion from grand-jury list versus master list in subsection 3. Six-month term and up-to-sixty-day extension solely for existing matters are not described as general new-case authority.

headings.title: Ten-year ineligibility after regular or alternate grand jury service
headings.reviewNote: Includes members and alternates, preserves repeated alternate source wording.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and history. Petit-juror rules are incorporated for grand jurors, and ten-year restriction includes alternate service. Repeated source reference to alternate is retained rather than silently repaired.
